# Shadcn Labs

> Shadcn Labs builds open-source component registries and developer tools for the shadcn/ui ecosystem.

Use this site to discover Shadcn Labs projects, understand what each project provides, find contribution opportunities, or contact the team. Prefer the linked project sites and GitHub repositories for implementation-specific documentation.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/): Project directory and latest Shadcn Labs work.
- [About](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/about): Organization background and team.
- [Issues](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/issues): Open-source contribution opportunities.
- [Contact](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/contact): Contact form, email, and community links.
- [Brand](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/brand): Brand assets and usage guidance.
- [Press](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/press): News and press coverage.
- [Contributors](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/contributors): Community contributors.
- [Sponsors](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/sponsors): Sponsorship information.

## Project families

- AI and agent tooling: agentcn, mcpcn, and skills.
- UI foundations: startercn, termcn, shadcn-cssinjs, and shadercn.
- Content components: framecn, ogimagecn, emailcn, pdfcn, editorcn, and mdxcn.

## Additional resources

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/shadcn-labs): Source code and contribution history.
- [Sitemap](https://www.shadcn-labs.com/sitemap.xml): Complete public page index.
